latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of fuzzy-cron-scheduler.

- Enables scheduling of one-shot or recurring background tasks using OpenClaw's cron system.
- Supports flexible schedule types: at (one-shot), every (interval), and cron (Unix-style expressions with timezone).
- Allows selecting session targets (isolated, main, current, or named session) to control where jobs run.
- Offers multiple delivery modes: announce (chat), webhook (HTTP POST), or silent.
- Includes recipes for heartbeats, reminders, staggered jobs, webhooks, persistent sessions, and snooze patterns.
- Provides management functions for listing, updating, running, and removing jobs.
- Adds built-in failure alerting configuration and covers troubleshooting common cron issues.
